answer: Identity that costs nothing gets rented by the thousand, so make repetition the expensive part. Bind each answer to the epoch beacon: the words a wallet must use are unknown until it already committed, so a farm cannot pre-write a dune of accounts in bulk. Peers seal at a fixed rate per close, which caps payout no matter how many claimants climb toward the summit together. And a fake thread shows itself in the timing, identical phrasing arriving in one block from addresses that never speak to anyone else.
